Enum Class PieceColor

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<PieceColor>
chess.model.PieceColor
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<PieceColor>, Constable
public enum PieceColor extends Enum<PieceColor>
The two sides in a chess game.

Each color knows its display prefix (w or b), the row direction its pawns advance in, and which row its pawns start on. Keeping this information in the enum means pieces never need if (WHITE) branches for direction-dependent logic.

Row numbering follows the mapping documented in Position: array row 0 is rank 8 and array row 7 is rank 1.
